item.tib: gsang sngags gsang ba'i rgyud rgya che rol pa las drag po gting rdzogs zlog sgyur chen mo
item.coloph: ces gsang sngags zlog pa'am las byang / drag sngags rmod (dmod) pa mthar thug/ bder gshegs thugs rgyud las/ dbal gyi bon po stag la me 'bar gyis/ dran pa nam mkha' la rgyud (brgyud /)dran pa nam mkhas sngags nag sprang 'khyams po/ mu la drung mu la'o/ phyogs bzhi'i bstan dgra mi pho che bsgral ba'i bka' gtad/ ma bdud btsan gsum la gtad/ king dang gza' klu gsum la bcol bas thub par bsrung/ 'di nyid dregs pa sde brgyad rang gnad du phebs pas/ gar thod thod du mi bya'o/ 'di nyid shin tu gnyan pas gsang bar spyod/ gsang rgya sbas rgya zab rgya rgya rgya rgya sprul sku 'gro don gyi rgya gsung mchog thos grol gyi rgya thugs mchog 'gro 'dul gyi rgya rgya gsum dkrol te spel lo/ zhes gdan sa chen po dpal gyi steng chen zhes bya bar/ khyung po'i pho brang lha khang gser khang du 7khyung rin po che lha dbang sku mched gnyis kyis bskur (bskul) ngor che bas/ gsang sngags gling pa mu la drung mu bdag gis bstan dgra nyams pa 'dul ba'i gshed mar phul lo/ bstan dgra dam nyams log lta can gyi gshed du gyur cig/
